source_inspection.web_observation: File comment says maps 27 manuscript chapters to 12 webapp chapters, but local source currently exposes 27 id fields. Developed vs placeholder/easter-egg status must be verified by content owners rather than inferred from count.
source_inspection.mobile_observation: JSON has chapters, rowCount, schemaVersion, datasetHash; chapters list count observed as 27 with sourceHash fields.

identity_model.manuscript_chapter_id: book_n/chapter_n in current v3 CHAPTERS source
identity_model.app_entry_id: surface-specific entry used by web/mobile UI or database
identity_model.practice_id: guided reusable practice introduced by a scene situation
identity_model.situation_id: portable dilemma unit: stimulus, interpretation, choice, consequence, return
identity_model.source_revision_id: hash of accepted manuscript candidate or protected baseline used for mapping

developed_entry_policy: Every developed companion entry needs a source revision hash, situation id, practice id, and owner. Placeholder/easter-egg entries must be marked placeholder; do not invent exercises to fill counts.
missing_or_retired_policy: Missing, placeholder, retired, and migrated entries remain explicit states. A retired entry can preserve alias history without being treated as current practice authority.

first_mapping_target.manuscript_source: CR-04 Chapter 6 review-only candidate, not yet canonical
